title: Efficient Poincar\'e Convolutions through Patch-Statistics Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Published implementations of the Poincar\'e convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincar\'e ball before evaluating its score. We show that the clipped score depends on each patch only through two statistics, its squared norm and its inner products with the filters, which a native convolution and a single-channel box filter compute directly. The factorized layer therefore evaluates the specified score exactly, without constructing ball-valued patches, and its single-precision outputs and gradients agree with double-precision evaluations at least as closely as those of the explicit reference. translated_title: 基于图像块统计量分解的高效庞加莱卷积
translated_abstract: 双曲神经网络++（HNN++）中已发表的庞加莱卷积实现在计算得分之前，需要将每个重叠的图像块映射到庞加莱球上。我们证明了该截断得分仅通过两个统计量依赖于每个图像块：其平方范数以及与滤波器的内积，而这两个统计量可以由原生卷积和单通道盒式滤波器直接计算得到。因此，该分解层无需构造球值图像块即可精确计算指定的得分，且其单精度输出和梯度与双精度计算结果的一致性不低于显式参考实现。在RTX A6000上、JAX的两个版本下，庞加莱U-Net和庞加莱ResNet-20的完整训练更新比两个将图像块映射到球上的显式实现中较快者快1.5至1.8倍（相比跳过该映射的显式实现则快1.2至1.4倍）。
tldr: 本文提出将庞加莱卷积得分分解为图像块的平方范数和与滤波器的内积两个统计量，由原生卷积直接计算，无需将图像块映射到庞加莱球即可精确求值，使训练速度提升1.2至1.8倍。
en_tdlr: This paper factorizes the Poincaré convolution score into two patch statistics (squared norm and filter inner products) computable by native convolutions, enabling exact score evaluation without mapping patches to the Poincaré ball and achieving 1.2–1.8× faster training.
